answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 19522 Country: India Title: my name is azeem some people told me that azeem is ALLAH name.. plz tell me is it right.if right so it is camplcary to keep 'abdul' fist from my name? Question: ASSALAM-O-LALEKUM,,, my name is azeem some people told me that azeem is ALLAH name.. plz tell me is it right.if right so it is camplcary to keep 'abdul' fist from my name? plz replay me fast, ALLAH HAFIZ. Answer ID: 19522 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 201/201/M=1431) You can keep your name either Abdul Azeem by adding Abdul before Azeem or only ?Azeem?. Azeem is amongst the common names of Allah. When applied for Almighty Allah it has different meaning in contrary to His slaves. If you do not have any difficulty, then choosing another name is better. وجاز التسمية بعلي و رشيد من الأسماء المشتركة ، و يراد في حقنا غير ما يراد في حق الله تعالى لكن التسمية بغير ذلك في زماننا أولى ، لأن العوام يصفرونها عن النداء ، كذا في السراجية۔ (درمختار). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
